reviews.name: Angie Gensmer
reviews.text: Service was fast and friendly. On top of refills for both water and coffee. American fries were hand sliced and delicious. Very "old school" diner complete with affordable prices. Bill for 2 was under $20 and I ordered a coffee! Nice stop along the way.

reviews.name: Ces D.
reviews.text: Visiting from Chicago. Was driving around and the old neon sign immediately caught my eye! Did a quick google and made it a point to go for breakfast. Simple, but welcoming. It was full of people but they have counter seating.

reviews.name: Dani C
reviews.text: Really good authentic American style breakfast place, the food was amazing. Recommended.

reviews.name: Google reviewer
reviews.text: Lovely place, hearty food, wonderful service and stellar coffee.

reviews.name: Google reviewer
reviews.text: Good prices for home-cooking, old fashioned food in an old local diner.
